notes.vocab_size: NOT fixed here — defined per model after preprocessing. Baseline: 32000. Morph: determined by attested morpheme inventory.
notes.feature_embedding: Morph models only. Size = num_feature_bundles x n_embd. Combined input = token_embedding + feature_embedding.
notes.scale_downgrade: Originally designed at 425M params / 8.4B tokens. Reduced to 125M / 2.5B due to compute budget constraints. See feasibility.md §11 for full rationale.
